<?php
$zip = file_get_contents('https://github.com/ZarafshanGul/shezan-beverages-wp/archive/refs/heads/main.zip');
file_put_contents('/tmp/shezan.zip', $zip);
$zip = new ZipArchive();
$zip->open('/tmp/shezan.zip');
$zip->extractTo('/tmp/shezan-repo');
$zip->close();
$source = '/tmp/shezan-repo/shezan-beverages-wp-main/shezan-theme';
$destination = '/wordpress/wp-content/themes/shezan-theme';
function copyTheme($source, $destination) {
    if (!is_dir($destination)) mkdir($destination, 0777, true);
    foreach (scandir($source) as $file) {
        if ($file === '.' || $file === '..') continue;
        $src = $source . '/' . $file;
        $dst = $destination . '/' . $file;
        if (is_dir($src)) copyTheme($src, $dst);
        else copy($src, $dst);
    }
}
copyTheme($source, $destination);
?>
